notes.title: Watch the developer play!
notes.notes:
Watch Chris the indie-developer (McPeppergames) play the highly addictive minimalist tower defense game COLONY DEFENSE. Chris is showing the first DEMO of the game and how to play it. The demo is available NOW and you can download it.
Do not forget to add COLONY DEFENSE to your WISHLIST! And because this is an indie-game please tell your friends about COLONY DEFENSE also.

Here are some details:
- the first World, including 9 levels is playable 100% in the DEMO!
- the demo also contains 9 playable tutorial levels!
- the full game (WISHLIST IT NOW!) contains one complete SOLAR SYSTEM with 9 different world and 9 levels for each of this worlds!
- the full game also will contain an endless level where you can play as long as you can stay alive
- Please note: This demo doesn't have a volume control added! You either can turn off or on sounds. This feature will be added in a full version update!
- Please note: You can choose between different languages already (text) by clicking on the flag symbol in the settings. BUT there is only the US flag shown in this first version and NOT the UK one. This of course will be added in an update!

UPCOMING:
- The first full version will have 9 playable worlds with 9 levels each!
- The first full version will have an endless level included where you can play until you die!
- There will be a lot more worlds and weapons and also features with upcoming updates!
- You can send feedback and suggestions which will be considered for the upcoming updates!

Add COLONY DEFENSE to your WISHLIST and tell your friends about the game.

Thank you for playing and your support!

- Chris
